name: Optimate
tagline: An underwriting dashboard that surfaces the submissions that best fit an insurer's appetite, using reinforcement learning.

awards: Federato: Best RiskOps Solution for Underwriters

problem: Underwriters sift large volumes of policy data to make high-stakes decisions under time pressure.
solution: Answers the sponsor's brief directly: on login, an RL and retrieval-backed model prioritizes in-appetite submissions, shown with heatmaps, search and plots.
demo_moment: Team-described: log in and see the top-priority submissions ranked.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Federato: Best RiskOps Solution for Underwriters” and “Y Combinator: Unicorn Prize” among 261 submissions.
Built against the sponsor's exact challenge statement.
Also won the startup-potential prize, so it read as a business.

lessons: Quote the sponsor's problem statement and answer it literally.
